parts.question: renal dosing guidance for moderate impairment and hepatic monitoring; hepatic monitoring and its escalation thresholds for hepatic; renal dosing by eGFR category for egfr, renal

result.answer: For moderate renal impairment (eGFR 30-59), the starting dose is 25 mg OD [E2] (also noted as 25 mg once daily [E1, E3]), the maximum is 50 mg/day, and monitoring is recheck 2-4 weeks [E2]. Renal dosing by eGFR category is as follows: Normal (>=90): starting dose 50 mg OD, maximum 100 mg/day, monitoring routine; Mild (60-89): starting dose 50 mg OD, maximum 100 mg/day, monitoring routine; Severe (15-29): starting dose specialist review, maximum 25 mg/day, monitoring enhanced [E2]. Baseline hepatic laboratory values are required with repeat testing between Day 14 and Day 21 [E1].
result.missing: Hepatic monitoring escalation thresholds are not covered in the evidence.
